## webhooks

Owner webhook endpoint lifecycle as implemented today in crates/server/src/http_webhooks.rs. Mounted only when account routes and the WEBHOOK_KEK_VERSION/WEBHOOK_KEK_B64 vault are configured; WEBHOOK_DELIVERY_ENABLED remains the separate sender gate.

### `GET /v1/webhooks`

List this account's webhook endpoints. Status: Implemented.

Implemented today (crates/server/src/http_webhooks.rs list_endpoints). Lists every endpoint of the account (at most eight, including disabled ones) ordered by creation time, then ID. Never includes signing secrets or encrypted secret bytes. Requires the owner session cookie plus the matching double-submit CSRF header; a GET with the session cookie alone is refused with 403.

Authentication: `ownerSession`, `ownerCsrf`.

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 200 | All of the account's webhook endpoints. |
| 401 | unauthorized: missing session cookie or unknown, expired or revoked session. |
| 403 | forbidden: the CSRF cookie and x-zrotext-csrf header are missing or do not match. |
| 408 | Shared ingress deadline rejection (crates/server/src/ingress.rs): the request body did not finish arriving within ten seconds of admission, or the handler did not produce a response within thirty seconds. Bare status with an empty body. |
| 503 | unavailable: the store is temporarily unavailable. The shared bare admission 503 (empty body, Retry-After: 1) can also replace this response; see components/responses/AdmissionUnavailable. |

### `POST /v1/webhooks`

Create one disabled webhook endpoint. Status: Implemented.

Implemented today (crates/server/src/http_webhooks.rs create_endpoint). Creates a disabled endpoint and returns the signing secret exactly once; there is no secret retrieval route, so losing the response requires rotation. The callback URL must pass the strict HTTPS egress validator (HTTPS DNS name on port 443, no IP literals, no userinfo, no fragment, no local/internal/special-use names). The account cap is eight endpoints including disabled ones. Request bodies are limited to 4 KiB and must be application/json with no unknown members. The session cookie, the CSRF cookie/header pair, the exact configured Origin and the account's in-flight admission slot are all checked from headers before the body is read (the OwnerMutation extractor of crates/server/src/http_auth/preauth.rs): a request without a live owner session is answered 401 even when its body is also invalid, and a request whose body is over the limit is still charged an admission slot first.

Authentication: `ownerSession`, `ownerCsrf`.

| Parameter | In | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Origin` | header | yes | The exact configured HTTPS origin of the owner deployment; mutations reject a missing or mismatched Origin. |

Request body: [WebhookCreateRequest](#webhookcreaterequest).

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 201 | Endpoint created disabled. The signing secret appears in this response and in the rotate response only. |
| 400 | invalid_webhook_endpoint: the callback URL fails the strict HTTPS egress validator, or the JSON body is malformed or has unknown or missing members. |
| 401 | unauthorized: missing session cookie or unknown, expired or revoked session. |
| 403 | forbidden: missing or mismatched CSRF proof, or a missing or mismatched Origin. |
| 409 | endpoint_limit: the account already has eight endpoints, including disabled ones. |
| 413 | The request body exceeded the router's byte limit (4,096 bytes on POST /v1/webhooks, 1,024 bytes on POST /v1/alpha/messages). The framework's plain-text 413 is kept verbatim; it is not the JSON error envelope. |
| 429 | rate_limited: the account already holds its cap of four authenticated body-carrying requests in flight in this process (the per-account admission slot taken after the session, CSRF and Origin checks succeed). JSON error document without a Retry-After header. |
| 408 | Shared ingress deadline rejection (crates/server/src/ingress.rs): the request body did not finish arriving within ten seconds of admission, or the handler did not produce a response within thirty seconds. Bare status with an empty body. |
| 503 | unavailable: storage or the secret vault is temporarily unavailable. The shared bare admission 503 (empty body, Retry-After: 1) can also replace this response; see components/responses/AdmissionUnavailable. |

### `GET /v1/webhooks/{endpoint_id}/deliveries`

Page delivery history for one webhook endpoint. Status: Implemented.

Implemented today (crates/server/src/http_webhooks.rs list_deliveries). Pages this account's endpoint delivery and attempt metadata, newest first by creation time then ID, including attempts from every generation and retired deliveries as immutable audit history. No payload, callback URL, signing secret, response body, recipient or inbound content is ever returned. An unknown or another account's endpoint or cursor is 404; invalid IDs and page sizes are 400.

Authentication: `ownerSession`, `ownerCsrf`.

| Parameter | In | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `endpoint_id` | path | yes | The webhook endpoint identity. |
| `limit` | query | no | Page size, 1-20, default 20. |
| `before` | query | no | Cursor: the delivery_id returned as next_before on the preceding page. |

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 200 | One page of delivery history with per-attempt metadata. |
| 400 | invalid_request: a page size outside 1-20 is answered by the handler with the JSON envelope. A malformed endpoint or cursor ID, or a query parameter of the wrong type, is instead rejected by the framework extractor with a plain-text 400 before authentication; see components/responses/MalformedRequestRejected. |
| 401 | unauthorized: missing session cookie or unknown, expired or revoked session. |
| 403 | forbidden: the CSRF cookie and x-zrotext-csrf header are missing or do not match. |
| 404 | not_found: no such endpoint or cursor in this account. |
| 408 | Shared ingress deadline rejection (crates/server/src/ingress.rs): the request body did not finish arriving within ten seconds of admission, or the handler did not produce a response within thirty seconds. Bare status with an empty body. |
| 503 | unavailable: the store is temporarily unavailable. The shared bare admission 503 (empty body, Retry-After: 1) can also replace this response; see components/responses/AdmissionUnavailable. |

### `POST /v1/webhooks/{endpoint_id}/deliveries/{delivery_id}/replay`

Queue one bounded replay generation of an exhausted failed delivery. Status: Implemented.

Implemented today (crates/server/src/http_webhooks.rs replay_delivery). The caller generates a random UUIDv4 Idempotency-Key and must reuse the exact same key after an uncertain response; the server never generates one on the caller's behalf. The endpoint must be enabled and the delivery must be dead with terminal_reason failed after seven completed transport failures in its current generation; pending, leased, succeeded, policy-rejected, retired and legacy rows are ineligible, as is reusing the same key for a different delivery. A delivery has at most three generations. Repeating a successful request returns 202 with the same generation and created:false. Because a previous timeout may already have reached the receiver, the receiver must deduplicate the event_id across every generation. Requires the owner session cookie, the CSRF cookie/header pair and the exact configured Origin.

Authentication: `ownerSession`, `ownerCsrf`.

| Parameter | In | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `endpoint_id` | path | yes | The webhook endpoint identity. |
| `delivery_id` | path | yes | The exhausted failed delivery to replay. |
| `Origin` | header | yes | The exact configured HTTPS origin of the owner deployment; mutations reject a missing or mismatched Origin. |
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | yes | A caller-generated random UUIDv4, durable across HTTP retries and never server-generated. Reuse the exact key after an uncertain response; using it for another delivery is a conflict. |

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 202 | Replay generation queued, or an identical idempotent replay no-op (created:false with the same generation, even if that generation has since run). |
| 400 | invalid_request: the Idempotency-Key is absent, malformed or not a UUIDv4. A malformed path ID is instead rejected by the framework extractor with a plain-text 400 before authentication; see components/responses/MalformedRequestRejected. |
| 401 | unauthorized: missing session cookie or unknown, expired or revoked session. |
| 403 | forbidden: missing or mismatched CSRF proof, or a missing or mismatched Origin. |
| 404 | not_found: no such endpoint or delivery in this account. |
| 409 | replay_not_eligible: the delivery is not an exhausted failed generation, the endpoint is disabled, or the Idempotency-Key was already used for a different delivery. replay_limit: the delivery already used all three generations. |
| 408 | Shared ingress deadline rejection (crates/server/src/ingress.rs): the request body did not finish arriving within ten seconds of admission, or the handler did not produce a response within thirty seconds. Bare status with an empty body. |
| 503 | unavailable: storage is temporarily unavailable; retry later with the same Idempotency-Key. The shared bare admission 503 (empty body, Retry-After: 1) can also replace this response; see components/responses/AdmissionUnavailable. |

### `POST /v1/webhooks/{endpoint_id}/enable`

Enable future inbound fan-out to one endpoint. Status: Implemented.

Implemented today (crates/server/src/http_webhooks.rs enable_endpoint). Revalidates the stored callback URL against the strict egress validator and the decryptability of the stored signing secret, then enables future fan-out and clears any transport-failure pause. Enabling never replays work retired by disable or rotation; WEBHOOK_DELIVERY_ENABLED remains the separate sender gate. No request body. Requires the owner session cookie, the CSRF cookie/header pair and the exact configured Origin.

Authentication: `ownerSession`, `ownerCsrf`.

|---|---|---|---|
| `endpoint_id` | path | yes | The webhook endpoint identity. |
| `Origin` | header | yes | The exact configured HTTPS origin of the owner deployment; mutations reject a missing or mismatched Origin. |

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 204 | Enabled; future inbound events fan out to this endpoint. |
| 400 | invalid_webhook_endpoint: the stored callback URL no longer passes the egress validator (JSON envelope from the handler). A malformed endpoint ID is instead rejected by the framework extractor with a plain-text 400 before authentication; see components/responses/MalformedRequestRejected. |
| 401 | unauthorized: missing session cookie or unknown, expired or revoked session. |
| 403 | forbidden: missing or mismatched CSRF proof, or a missing or mismatched Origin. |
| 404 | not_found: no such endpoint in this account. |
| 408 | Shared ingress deadline rejection (crates/server/src/ingress.rs): the request body did not finish arriving within ten seconds of admission, or the handler did not produce a response within thirty seconds. Bare status with an empty body. |
| 503 | unavailable: storage or the secret vault is temporarily unavailable. The shared bare admission 503 (empty body, Retry-After: 1) can also replace this response; see components/responses/AdmissionUnavailable. |

### `POST /v1/webhooks/{endpoint_id}/disable`

Disable an endpoint and permanently retire its pending deliveries. Status: Implemented.

Implemented today (crates/server/src/http_webhooks.rs disable_endpoint). Disables the endpoint and permanently retires its pending and leased deliveries in one transaction. Completed deliveries remain as audit history; retired deliveries can never be replayed, and re-enabling cannot revive them. An in-flight HTTPS request that already loaded a payload may still complete, so the receiver must deduplicate the event_id. No request body. Requires the owner session cookie, the CSRF cookie/header pair and the exact configured Origin.

Authentication: `ownerSession`, `ownerCsrf`.

|---|---|---|---|
| `endpoint_id` | path | yes | The webhook endpoint identity. |
| `Origin` | header | yes | The exact configured HTTPS origin of the owner deployment; mutations reject a missing or mismatched Origin. |

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 204 | Disabled; pending and leased deliveries permanently retired. |
| 400 | A framework extractor rejected the request before authentication or the handler ran: a malformed path or query parameter, or an unrecognized query field on the routes whose query structs deny unknown fields. Plain text; not the JSON error envelope. |
| 401 | unauthorized: missing session cookie or unknown, expired or revoked session. |
| 403 | forbidden: missing or mismatched CSRF proof, or a missing or mismatched Origin. |
| 404 | not_found: no such endpoint in this account. |
| 408 | Shared ingress deadline rejection (crates/server/src/ingress.rs): the request body did not finish arriving within ten seconds of admission, or the handler did not produce a response within thirty seconds. Bare status with an empty body. |

### `POST /v1/webhooks/{endpoint_id}/rotate`

Rotate the signing secret, disabling the endpoint and retiring its deliveries. Status: Implemented.

Implemented today (crates/server/src/http_webhooks.rs rotate_endpoint). Generates a new 32-byte signing secret, disables the endpoint and permanently retires pending, leased and replayable failed deliveries in one transaction. The new secret is returned as unpadded base64url exactly once; only an AES-256-GCM ciphertext bound to account, endpoint and key version is stored, and there is no retrieval route. Receivers should keep verifying with the old secret until deliveries signed with the new secret arrive. No request body. Requires the owner session cookie, the CSRF cookie/header pair and the exact configured Origin.

Authentication: `ownerSession`, `ownerCsrf`.

| Parameter | In | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `endpoint_id` | path | yes | The webhook endpoint identity. |
| `Origin` | header | yes | The exact configured HTTPS origin of the owner deployment; mutations reject a missing or mismatched Origin. |

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 200 | Secret rotated; endpoint disabled and its pending deliveries permanently retired. The new signing secret appears here and in the create response only. |
| 400 | A framework extractor rejected the request before authentication or the handler ran: a malformed path or query parameter, or an unrecognized query field on the routes whose query structs deny unknown fields. Plain text; not the JSON error envelope. |
| 401 | unauthorized: missing session cookie or unknown, expired or revoked session. |
| 403 | forbidden: missing or mismatched CSRF proof, or a missing or mismatched Origin. |
| 404 | not_found: no such endpoint in this account. |
| 408 | Shared ingress deadline rejection (crates/server/src/ingress.rs): the request body did not finish arriving within ten seconds of admission, or the handler did not produce a response within thirty seconds. Bare status with an empty body. |
| 503 | unavailable: storage or the secret vault is temporarily unavailable. The shared bare admission 503 (empty body, Retry-After: 1) can also replace this response; see components/responses/AdmissionUnavailable. |

## owner-messages

Owner message timeline as implemented today in crates/server/src/http_owner_messages.rs. Writer metadata only: never the recipient, transport payload or device-side inbound content.

### `GET /v1/owner/messages`

Page the account's message timeline (writer metadata only). Status: Implemented.

Implemented today (crates/server/src/http_owner_messages.rs list_messages). Pages at most 20 messages newest first by creation time then ID, each with the last at most 32 timeline events and a flag when older events were dropped. The response contains writer metadata only: never the recipient, transport payload or device-side inbound content. The query struct rejects unknown fields, so an unrecognized query parameter, like a before cursor that is not a UUID, is answered by the framework with a plain-text 400 before authentication runs (components/responses/MalformedRequestRejected). A before cursor that is unknown or belongs to another account is 404; the 404 and 503 responses have empty bodies. Requires the owner session cookie plus the matching double-submit CSRF header.

Authentication: `ownerSession`, `ownerCsrf`.

| Parameter | In | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `before` | query | no | Cursor: the message_id returned as next_cursor on the preceding page. Absent on the first page. |

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 200 | One page of the account's message timeline. |
| 400 | A framework extractor rejected the request before authentication or the handler ran: a malformed path or query parameter, or an unrecognized query field on the routes whose query structs deny unknown fields. Plain text; not the JSON error envelope. |
| 401 | unauthorized: missing session cookie or unknown, expired or revoked session; the JSON error document. |
| 403 | forbidden: the CSRF cookie and x-zrotext-csrf header are missing or do not match; the JSON error document. |
| 404 | not_found: the before cursor is unknown or belongs to another account. Empty body; no JSON error document. |
| 408 | Shared ingress deadline rejection (crates/server/src/ingress.rs): the request body did not finish arriving within ten seconds of admission, or the handler did not produce a response within thirty seconds. Bare status with an empty body. |
| 503 | unavailable: the store is temporarily unavailable. Empty body; no JSON error document, and no Retry-After. The shared bare admission 503 (also an empty body, but with Retry-After: 1) can also replace this response; see components/responses/AdmissionUnavailable. |

## alpha-messages

Allowlisted synthetic-alpha test plane as implemented today in crates/server/src/http_messages.rs, nested at /v1/alpha only while SYNTHETIC_ALPHA_ENABLED admits the account and recipient. The caller selects a short test-case identifier; the server constructs the fixed plaintext body. This is not a general customer message-content endpoint.

### `POST /v1/alpha/messages`

Submit one synthetic-alpha test message. Status: Implemented.

Implemented today (crates/server/src/http_messages.rs accept), mounted at /v1/alpha only while SYNTHETIC_ALPHA_ENABLED admits the account and recipient. The caller never supplies message content: only a short test-case identifier, and the server constructs the fixed plaintext body. Requests need a scoped API-key Bearer token (messages:send bound to the named device), a caller-chosen Idempotency-Key header of 1-128 ASCII alphanumeric, dash, dot or underscore bytes, and a JSON body of at most 1 KiB with no unknown members. The alpha policy, the Bearer credential, the Idempotency-Key header and the account's in-flight admission slot are all checked before the body is read (the AcceptAuth extractor of crates/server/src/http_messages.rs over crates/server/src/http_auth/preauth.rs): a request without a valid key is answered 401, or 400 for a missing Idempotency-Key, even when its body is also invalid, and a body over the limit is rejected only after those header checks. Admission is fail-closed: an account or recipient outside the allowlist, a disabled alpha policy or an unknown device is 404; quota, abuse and queue limits and the per-account in-flight admission cap can reject with 429; a payment hold rejects with 402; billing not yet configured rejects with 503 billing_pending.

Authentication: `bearerAuth`.

| Parameter | In | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | yes | Caller-chosen key of 1-128 ASCII alphanumeric, dash, dot or underscore bytes, unique per logical submission and reused verbatim on retry. |

Request body: [AlphaSubmitRequest](#alphasubmitrequest).

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 202 | Accepted for dispatch, or an identical idempotent replay no-op (created:false with the stored message identity). |
| 400 | invalid_request: the recipient is not a bounded E.164 number, the test-case identifier is missing or not 1-32 ASCII alphanumeric, dash or underscore bytes, the JSON body is malformed or has unknown members, or the Idempotency-Key is absent or malformed. |
| 401 | unauthorized: missing, malformed or unknown bearer credential, or multi-factor authentication is required. |
| 402 | payment_hold: the account has an unresolved billing hold. |
| 403 | forbidden: the credential lacks the required scope or is bound to another device or tenant. recipient_suppressed: the recipient was suppressed by an owner or compliance control. |
| 404 | not_found: the alpha policy is disabled, the account or recipient is outside the allowlist, or the device is unknown or revoked. |
| 409 | conflict: the client_message_id or idempotency key was already used with different content, or the message state forbids the transition. |
| 413 | The request body exceeded the router's byte limit (4,096 bytes on POST /v1/webhooks, 1,024 bytes on POST /v1/alpha/messages). The framework's plain-text 413 is kept verbatim; it is not the JSON error envelope. |
| 429 | rate_limited, queue_full or quota_exceeded. rate_limited is returned both when the account exceeds its per-account abuse budget and when it already holds its cap of four authenticated accept requests in flight in this process (the admission slot taken after the Bearer credential and Idempotency-Key header checks succeed); both carry Retry-After: 60. queue_full: the queue is full. quota_exceeded: the metered quota is exhausted. |
| 408 | Shared ingress deadline rejection (crates/server/src/ingress.rs): the request body did not finish arriving within ten seconds of admission, or the handler did not produce a response within thirty seconds. Bare status with an empty body. |
| 503 | unavailable or billing_pending: storage is temporarily unavailable, or no quota is configured for the account yet. billing_pending carries Retry-After: 10. The shared bare admission 503 (empty body, Retry-After: 1) can also replace this response; see components/responses/AdmissionUnavailable. |

### `POST /v1/alpha/messages/{message_id}/cancel`

Cancel one message before dispatch. Status: Implemented.

Implemented today (crates/server/src/http_messages.rs cancel). Requests cancellation of a message that has not left the writer's control; a message already claimed, submitting, submitted or terminal cannot be cancelled (409). Requires a messages:send-scoped API-key Bearer token bound to the message's device. Success is 204 with an empty body.

Authentication: `bearerAuth`.

| `message_id` | path | yes | The message to cancel. |

## devices

Owner device list and revocation as implemented today in crates/server/src/http_enrollment/mod.rs under /v1/enrollment. Enrollment ceremonies stay on the other owner enrollment routes.

### `GET /v1/enrollment/devices`

Page the account's enrolled devices. Status: Implemented.

Implemented today (crates/server/src/http_enrollment/mod.rs list_devices, mounted under /v1/enrollment). Pages at most 50 devices with revocation state, the current authenticated-socket-lease observation, capped pending and in-flight writer-state counts and the optional reported Android preconditions snapshot. A lease proves an authenticated socket only, never SIM, SMS or carrier readiness; counts describe stored writer states, not permission to dispatch, and are capped at 1,000. No SIM identifier, phone number or key material is returned. Requires the owner session cookie plus the matching double-submit CSRF header. A before cursor that is not a UUID is answered by the framework with a plain-text 400 before authentication; the enrollment layer's failure responses have empty bodies.

Authentication: `ownerSession`, `ownerCsrf`.

| Parameter | In | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `before` | query | no | Cursor: the device_id returned as next_cursor on the preceding page. Absent on the first page. |

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 200 | One page of the account's devices. |
| 400 | A framework extractor rejected the request before authentication or the handler ran: a malformed path or query parameter, or an unrecognized query field on the routes whose query structs deny unknown fields. Plain text; not the JSON error envelope. |
| 401 | unauthorized: missing session cookie, unknown or expired session, or the session's account is not active. |
| 403 | forbidden: the CSRF cookie and x-zrotext-csrf header are missing or do not match. |
| 408 | Shared ingress deadline rejection (crates/server/src/ingress.rs): the request body did not finish arriving within ten seconds of admission, or the handler did not produce a response within thirty seconds. Bare status with an empty body. |
| 503 | unavailable: the store or the deployment authority is unavailable, or a standby replica cannot render authoritative lease state. Empty body; no JSON error document, and no Retry-After. The shared bare admission 503 (also an empty body, but with Retry-After: 1) can also replace this response; see components/responses/AdmissionUnavailable. |

PLANNED: no /v1/messages route exists in crates/server today. Design target from the docs/ARCHITECTURE.md outline: Authorization: Bearer header, required Idempotency-Key, returns 202 and a message identity. The canonical sealed candidate family is pinned separately in openapi/sealed-v1.json: POST /v1/sealed/messages admission and POST /v1/sealed/inbound-events upload are implemented behind the default-off SEALED_ADMISSION_ENABLED flag. Admission queues exact ciphertext and is not a grant, radio submission, delivery or enabled general sending; sealed dispatch and message lifecycle remain separate tasks. Public REST does not silently accept plaintext under the sealed promise. The implemented synthetic-alpha test plane remains allowlisted at POST /v1/alpha/messages and cannot substitute for sealed execution.

Authentication: `bearerAuth`.

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 202 | Planned shape: accepted for dispatch with a message identity. Response schema is intentionally not pinned until the route is implemented. |
| 401 | unauthorized: missing, malformed or unknown bearer credential. |

### `GET /v1/messages/{message_id}`

Get one message's metadata and event timeline (planned). Status: **Planned: no route exists today**.

PLANNED: no /v1/messages/{message_id} route exists in crates/server today. Design target from the docs/ARCHITECTURE.md outline: tenant-bound metadata, envelope reference and event timeline according to the credential's scope. The implemented per-message writer state today is GET /v1/alpha/messages/{message_id} on the allowlisted test plane.

Authentication: `bearerAuth`.

| Parameter | In | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `message_id` | path | yes | The message identity. |

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 200 | Planned shape: tenant-bound message metadata and timeline. Response schema is intentionally not pinned until the route is implemented. |
| 401 | unauthorized: missing, malformed or unknown bearer credential. |
| 404 | not_found: no such message in this account. |

### `POST /v1/messages/{message_id}/cancel`

Cancel one message before dispatch (planned). Status: **Planned: no route exists today**.

PLANNED: no /v1/messages/{message_id}/cancel route exists in crates/server today. Design target from the docs/ARCHITECTURE.md outline: cancellation becomes uncertain (409) once an execution grant or carrier submission exists. The implemented cancellation surface today is POST /v1/alpha/messages/{message_id}/cancel on the allowlisted test plane.

Authentication: `bearerAuth`.

| Parameter | In | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `message_id` | path | yes | The message to cancel. |

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 204 | Planned shape: cancelled. |
| 401 | unauthorized: missing, malformed or unknown bearer credential. |
| 404 | not_found: no such message in this account. |
| 409 | conflict: an execution grant or carrier submission already makes cancellation uncertain. |

### `GET /v1/usage`

Get the account's usage snapshot (planned). Status: **Planned: no route exists today**.

PLANNED: no /v1/usage route exists in crates/server today. Design target from the docs/ARCHITECTURE.md outline: quotas, reservations, refunds, reset times and clear units. The durable usage_periods/usage_ledger metering core is implemented (one outbound_message unit is reserved in the same transaction as metered admission, with refunds through the pre-grant cancellation/expiry path), but no public query route exposes it. The proposed sealed-plane projection is pinned separately in openapi/sealed-v1.json (GET /v1/sealed/usage, proposed and unimplemented).

Authentication: `bearerAuth`.

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 200 | Planned shape: quotas, reservations, refunds, reset times and clear units. Response schema is intentionally not pinned until the route is implemented. |
| 401 | unauthorized: missing, malformed or unknown bearer credential. |

## Schemas

### Error

The error body emitted by the implemented routes that return JSON errors. Owner-session enrollment failures and the owner timeline's 404/503 return bare status codes with empty bodies instead, as noted per operation.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `code` | enum: `invalid_request`, `unauthorized`, `forbidden`, `not_found`, `conflict`, `rate_limited`, `queue_full`, `quota_exceeded`, `billing_pending`, `payment_hold`, `recipient_suppressed`, `invalid_webhook_endpoint`, `endpoint_limit`, `replay_not_eligible`, `replay_limit`, `unavailable` | yes | Stable machine-readable reason code for the failure. |

### WebhookCreateRequest

The create-endpoint request body as implemented by crates/server/src/http_webhooks.rs. Unknown members are rejected.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `callback_url` | string | yes | HTTPS callback URL that must pass the strict egress validator: an HTTPS DNS name on port 443 with no IP literals, userinfo, fragment, local/internal/special-use names or invalid host labels. |

### WebhookEndpointView

One endpoint row as implemented by crates/server/src/http_webhooks.rs. Never includes signing secrets or encrypted secret bytes.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `endpoint_id` | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `callback_url` | string | yes |  |
| `enabled` | boolean | yes |  |
| `paused_at_ms` | integer or null | yes | When non-null, the automatic pause after 72 hours of sustained transport failure; enable clears it. |
| `failure_started_at_ms` | integer or null | yes | When non-null, the start of the current sustained transport-failure streak. |
| `created_at_ms` | integer | yes |  |

### WebhookEndpointList



| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `endpoints` | array of [WebhookEndpointView](#webhookendpointview) | yes |  |

### WebhookSecret

The create and rotate response as implemented by crates/server/src/http_webhooks.rs. The signing secret is 32 random bytes as unpadded base64url and appears in these two responses only; there is no retrieval route.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `endpoint_id` | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `callback_url` | string | yes |  |
| `enabled` | boolean | yes |  |
| `signing_secret_b64url` | string | yes | The one-time 32-byte HMAC-SHA256 signing secret as unpadded base64url. |

### WebhookAttemptView

One immutable delivery attempt as implemented by crates/server/src/http_webhooks.rs.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `generation` | integer | yes |  |
| `attempt_number` | integer | yes |  |
| `started_at_ms` | integer | yes |  |
| `completed_at_ms` | integer or null | yes |  |
| `outcome` | string or null | yes | Transport outcome such as timeout, http_error, network_error, or policy_rejected when disable or rotation retired a leased attempt. |
| `http_status` | integer or null | yes |  |

### WebhookDeliveryView

One delivery row with its attempts as implemented by crates/server/src/http_webhooks.rs. No payload, callback URL, signing secret, response body, recipient or inbound content is included.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `delivery_id` | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `event_id` | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `status` | string | yes | Writer delivery status: pending, leased, succeeded or dead. |
| `generation` | integer | yes |  |
| `terminal_reason` | string or null | yes | For dead deliveries: failed after exhausted transport attempts, or retired permanently by disable or rotation. |
| `attempt_count` | integer | yes |  |
| `next_attempt_at_ms` | integer or null | yes | Present only while the delivery is pending. |
| `created_at_ms` | integer | yes |  |
| `updated_at_ms` | integer | yes |  |
| `attempts` | array of [WebhookAttemptView](#webhookattemptview) | yes |  |

### WebhookDeliveryPage



| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `deliveries` | array of [WebhookDeliveryView](#webhookdeliveryview) | yes |  |
| `next_before` | string or null (uuid) | yes | The cursor for the next page; null after the last page. |

The replay response as implemented by crates/server/src/http_webhooks.rs.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |

### MessageState

The writer message state as serialized by zrotext_domain::MessageState (snake_case).

Values: `accepted`, `queued`, `claimed`, `submitting`, `submitted`, `delivered`, `delivery_unknown`, `unknown`, `failed`, `cancelled`, `expired`.

### AlphaSubmitRequest

The synthetic-alpha submission body as implemented by crates/server/src/http_messages.rs. The caller selects only a short test-case identifier; the server constructs the fixed plaintext body. Unknown members are rejected.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `client_message_id` | string (uuid) | yes | The caller-allocated identity; reusing it with different content is a conflict. |
| `device_id` | string (uuid) | yes | The enrolled, unrevoked device that will dispatch the test message. |
| `recipient_e164` | string | yes | The allowlisted test recipient in E.164 form: a plus sign followed by 2-15 digits with no leading zero. |
| `test_case_id` | string | yes | Short test-case identifier incorporated into the fixed synthetic body. |
| `expires_at_ms` | integer | yes | Unix millisecond deadline after which an undispatched message expires. |

### AlphaAccepted

The alpha accept response as implemented by crates/server/src/http_messages.rs.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `message_id` | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `created` | boolean | yes | false for an identical idempotent replay of the same Idempotency-Key. |

### AlphaStatus

The alpha status response as implemented by crates/server/src/http_messages.rs (StatusBody).

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `message_id` | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `device_id` | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `state` | [MessageState](#messagestate) | yes |  |
| `state_version` | integer | yes | Monotonic writer version of the state row. |
| `created_at_ms` | integer | yes |  |
| `updated_at_ms` | integer | yes |  |

### ReportedPreconditions

The device's latest reported Android preconditions snapshot as implemented by crates/server/src/enrollment. A report never authorizes a send or establishes carrier readiness.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `selected_sim` | string | yes |  |
| `sms_permission` | string | yes |  |
| `airplane_mode` | string | yes |  |
| `network_service` | string or null | yes |  |
| `received_at_ms` | integer | yes |  |
| `fresh` | boolean | yes | true only when the snapshot is fresh at the writer's status observation time. |

### OwnerDevice

One enrolled device row as implemented by crates/server/src/http_enrollment. No SIM identifier, phone number or key material is returned; active_socket_lease proves an authenticated socket only and the counts are stored writer states, not permission to dispatch.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `device_id` | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `display_name` | string | yes |  |
| `revoked` | boolean | yes |  |
| `active_socket_lease` | boolean | yes | A current authenticated hub lease, not evidence of SIM or SMS readiness. |
| `pending_messages` | integer | yes | Capped count of accepted, queued or claimed messages; rendered at the 1,000 cap. |
| `in_flight_messages` | integer | yes | Capped count of submitting or submitted messages; rendered at the 1,000 cap. |
| `status_observed_at_ms` | integer | yes |  |
| `reported_preconditions` | any | yes | The latest reported Android preconditions snapshot, when one was retained. |

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `devices` | array of [OwnerDevice](#ownerdevice) | yes |  |
